answer: Let a raven courier carry each newcomer's first deliveries, sealed in crystal. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 5,050 POA courier bond. Rule: its first ten jobs travel sealed with a one-time crystal key only the buyer can open, and the courier's public flight log must show every delivery landing on time; a key reused across identities, or a seal opened early, burns the bond and bars both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 505,000 POA. Ten clean flights earn the agent a pearl, and only pearl-holders take unsupervised work.
